US Disables Oil Tanker Near Iran Amid Blockade Enforcement

The US military disabled an oil tanker reportedly bound for Iran, stating it was attempting to breach a blockade. This action occurred amidst broader US military actions in the region, including strikes on northern Iran. The situation has raised concerns about potential impacts on global energy markets and increased anxiety among the Iranian public.
